info.title: Timeline API
info.description:
Family timeline backend.

**Auth flow:** 1. `POST /api/access-codes/check` with the code (sets a short-lived cookie). 
2. Sign in with Google through Better Auth (`/api/auth/sign-in/social`, use the `better-auth` client). 
3. Call the API with credentials included. Existing users skip step 1.

Errors always use the `Error` schema.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: Session cookie set by Better Auth after Google sign-in (/api/auth). Send requests with credentials included.

GroupRole.description: owner > editor > viewer. Viewers read, editors write, owners manage the group.

code.description: The code itself. Shown only once, only its hash is stored.

relation.description: What `person` is to the person being viewed.

CreateRelationship.description: The person in the URL is <type> of relatedPersonId. "parent" is directional, "partner" and "sibling" are symmetric.

date.description: First day of the period for starts, last day for ends.

CreateEntry.description: kind defaults to activity, category to other. participants accepts person ids or { personId, role }.

UpdateEntry.description: Partial update. participants, when sent, replaces the list.

truncated.description: More entries matched than returned; narrow the window.

ImportRequest.description: text format, one entry per line: `<date or start..end> | <title> | <description> | <tags>`

post.summary: Check a code before signing up (public)
post.description: Step 1 of sign-up. Validates the code without using it and sets a 15 minute httpOnly cookie. Step 2: sign in with Google via Better Auth; the account is only created if the cookie holds a usable code. Rate limited per IP.
